password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.

issues.contains_login_id: It must not contain your login ID.
issues.repeated_character: It must not be one character repeated.
issues.too_common: It is too common. Choose a less predictable password.
issues.same_as_current: It must be different from your current password.
issues.other: It does not meet the password policy.
